# $1TAP

> $1TAP is a community-driven gaming memecoin on the Base network that combines FPS culture with crypto: tap-to-earn gameplay, NFT drops, locked liquidity, and fair-launch tokenomics.

$1TAP fuses competitive shooter nostalgia with on-chain mechanics. The token has a fixed 100M supply, locked LP, multi-sig treasury, and powers a tap-to-earn game with FPS-style ranks and craftable NFT items.
